## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. Explain any missing environment
proof; ordinary contributors are not expected to hold upstream signing credentials.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and module ownership match the change; required ADR approval is recorded.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, including `make verify` for native changes.
- [ ] Documentation and compatibility/migration notes are current where needed.
- [ ] Commits include DCO sign-off; media has explicit redistribution evidence.
- [ ] No credentials, private reports, generated projects, or unrelated changes are included.

For UI changes, attach sanitized screenshots and accessibility checks. For
performance claims, include the measurements required by ARCHITECTURE.md.
